```sql
SELECT DISTINCT 
    p.ID,
    p.Birthday,
    p.Diagnosis
FROM main."Patient" p
INNER JOIN main."Laboratory" l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date >= DATE '1997-01-01' 
  AND l.Date < DATE '1998-01-01'
  AND l.GOT >= 60
  AND l.Date <= DATE '1998-06-01'
```
